build: lipi-cli built with NDK 28.2, arm64-v8a, Release, ncnn 20261020 prebuilt for Android, learned detector
note: Detection of one 640 x 480 preview frame, median and 95th percentile in milliseconds over 30 runs after a warm-up, default CPU scheduling. Two rounds taken alternately (round 1 / round 2) so both models saw the same conditions. 'full' is the PageNet architecture of page-net and page-net-v3 (687,145 parameters, 538 MFLOPs); 'small' is page-net-small (width 0.6, 255,608 parameters, 203 MFLOPs).
